mapper.select: SELECT kind, code, label FROM preference_presets WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY kind, sort_order
SELECT source_type AS sourceType, preset_code AS presetCode, custom_value AS customValue FROM preference_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = #{kind} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT budget_enabled AS enabled, daily_budget AS dailyBudget FROM user_budget_histories WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND effective_date <= #{businessDate} ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_budget_histories (id, user_id, budget_enabled, daily_budget, effective_date) VALUES ( #{budget.id}, #{budget.userId}, #{budget.enabled}, #{budget.dailyBudget}, #{budget.effectiveDate} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE budget_enabled = VALUES(budget_enabled), daily_budget = VALUES(daily_budget)
